<b>Cogwork Spines</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are winged [[Cogwork Bugs|automatons]] able to extend spikes in a circular field.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Cogwork Spines fly up and down in a set path, stopping at regular intervals to extend 8 short spines in all directions.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Cogwork Spines have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* ...Am I...Who?...
* ...Lift it...Fix it...Me?...
* ...The Core...Holy...
* ...Work...Eternal...
* ...To mend...
* ...To serve...
}}

== Location ==
Cogwork Spines can be found in the [[Cogwork Core]], and three of them are fought as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the southwest of the area.

== Trivia ==
* Despite being a "passive" enemy, Cogwork Spines are always aware of Hornet and will face in her direction while she is in the same room, regardless of distance. This allows them to be pulled in by [[Challenge]] from anywhere in the same room.
